[SWS_CRYPT_02416] Signing
⌈
The interface ara::crypto::cryp::SignerPrivateCtx::Sign shall execute
the signing algorithm configured for this context. The interface shall write the computed
signature encoded according to the specified FormatId into the provided output buffer
and return the number of Bytes written or
• kInsufficientCapacity, if the provided output buffer does not have sufficient
capacity.
• kUnsupportedFormat, if specified format is not supported.
• kUninitializedContext,
if
ara::crypto::cryp::SignerPrivate-
Ctx::SetKey was not called before.
• kInvalidInputSize, if a supplied ara::crypto::ReadOnlyMemRegion
parameter’s size is incompatible with the configured signature algorithm.
